forms.label: Standard
forms.sourceNote: A gin-based fruit-cup liqueur, first sold in 1823. Current UK bottlings state 25% ABV. No producer sugar figure is published, so sugarGPer100 is left off rather than estimated; kcal is derived from the stated ABV alone (7 kcal/g alcohol) as a floor, since sugar would only add to it. Density has no liquid measurement on file and is taken from the liqueur-sweet class in density-classes.json (reference point near 25% ABV), marked estimated. Botanicals are herbal and citrus; no dairy, egg or other animal input is declared on the label.
